Name: RRRR Nyapu Version 2.0 with Hair and Seasonal Outfits
Author: AlmostMidnight
Description:
I promised this mod ages ago but my laptop died and so it got delayed by a few weeks. :P

I love using RRRR and I love Jello's wizard that they made for the mod but I also play with Nyapu's portrait mods for all the other villagers, so I created this mod to still have Jello's wizard but in the style of Nyapu. There is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22928]another mod[/url] that uses Nyapu's younger wizard if you prefer that instead, it just comes down to preference. In my case, I wanted to stick as closely to Jello's wizard as possible. The reason I call this 2.0 though is actually because I made a first draft so to speak of this mod but it turned out awful so I redid the entire thing haha.

Whether you use event edition or config edition, you need to have Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard installed for this mod to work as mine only replaces the files in the original mod.

Installation:

1. Download Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard
2. Download my mod, only pick one version.
3. Unzip the folder, you'll see [CP]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard and [CP]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard Config Edition.
4. Drop one or the other into your mods folder depending on which have installed.
4. Replace any files and done!
